```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(tinytex)



```
load games 

```{r}
games <- readRDS("wnba_pbp_2014-2023.rds")




```


seperate training set
```{r}

wnba_train <- games %>%
  filter(ymd(game_date)<"2022-12-31") %>%
  transmute(game_id,event_id=id,team_id,
            event_type=type_text,
            scoring_play,
            date=game_date,quarter=qtr,
            quarter_time=if_else(quarter<5,
                                 10-(clock_minutes+clock_seconds/60),
                                 5-(clock_minutes+clock_seconds/60)),
            game_time=if_else(quarter<5,
                              (quarter-1)*10+quarter_time,
                              40+quarter_time),
            home_team_id,home_score,
            away_team_id,away_score,
            home_margin=home_score-away_score) %>%
  arrange(date,game_id,quarter,quarter_time)

#create home winner data
home_win <- wnba_train %>%
  group_by(game_id) %>%
  slice_tail(n=1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(game_id,
            home_win=as.factor(if_else(home_margin>0,"Yes","No")))



#join home winner data to training set
wnba_train2 <- wnba_train %>%
  left_join(home_win,
            by="game_id")

#review training data
glimpse(wnba_train2)

```


```{r}


```



```{r}




```

```{r}
#create logistic regression model
log_model <- glm(home_win~game_time*home_margin,
                 data=wnba_train2,
                 family="binomial")

#review model
summary(log_model)
```

must still test the model yeah aii

```{r}


wnba_test <- games %>%
  filter(between(ymd(game_date),
                 ymd("2023-01-01"),
                 ymd("2023-12-31")),
         scoring_play == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(game_id) %>%
  filter(max(period_number) < 5) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(game_id, event_id = id,
            date = game_date, quarter = qtr,
            quarter_time = if_else(quarter < 5,
                                   10 - (clock_minutes + clock_seconds/60),
                                   5  - (clock_minutes + clock_seconds/60)),
            game_time = if_else(quarter < 5,
                                (quarter - 1) * 10 + quarter_time,
                                40 + quarter_time),
            home_team = as.factor(home_team_name), home_score,
            away_team = as.factor(away_team_name), away_score,
            home_margin = home_score - away_score) %>%
  arrange(date, game_id, quarter, quarter_time)




# create win or loss variable

home_win <- wnba_test %>%
  group_by(game_id) %>%
  slice_tail(n=1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(game_id,
            home_win=as.factor(if_else(home_margin>0,"Yes","No")))



wnba_test_44 <- wnba_test %>%
  left_join(home_win,
            by="game_id")

```

testing testing...
```{r}
#predict testing data
test_log_predict <- predict(log_model,
                       newdata=wnba_test,
                       type="response")

#add predictions to test set
wnba_test_real <- wnba_test_44 %>%
  mutate(home_prob=test_log_predict)


mean((wnba_test_real$home_prob >= 0.5) == (wnba_test_real$home_win == "Yes"), na.rm = TRUE)

# 77.68% accuracy is pretty good 

```



my game


```{r}
new_games <- readRDS("wnba_pbp_2024.rds")

my_game <- new_games %>%
  filter(game_id == 401620396)







wnba_test1 <- my_game %>%
  filter(scoring_play ==TRUE) %>%
  transmute(game_id,event_id=id,
            date=game_date,quarter=qtr,
            quarter_time=if_else(quarter<5,
                                 10-(clock_minutes+clock_seconds/60),
                                 5-(clock_minutes+clock_seconds/60)),
            game_time=if_else(quarter<5,
                              (quarter-1)*10+quarter_time,
                              40+quarter_time),
            home_team=as.factor(home_team_name),home_score,
            away_team=as.factor(away_team_name),away_score,
            home_margin=home_score-away_score) %>%
  arrange(date,game_id,quarter,quarter_time)


log_predict <- predict(log_model,
                       newdata=wnba_test1,
                       type="response")

#add predictions to test set
wnba_test12 <- wnba_test1 %>%
  mutate(home_prob=log_predict)

#review test set
glimpse(wnba_test12)

```




```{r}
ggplot(data=wnba_test12,
       mapping=aes(x=game_time,y=home_prob)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(10,20,30),
             linetype="dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.5) +
  labs(title="Dallas vs Las Vegas",
       x="Game Time (minutes)",
       y="Home Win Probability",
       caption="Source: ESPN via wehoop") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,40),breaks=seq(0,40,5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,1),breaks=seq(0,1,0.1)) +
  theme_bw()



```



```{r}
wnba_test13 <- data.table::rbindlist(
  list(
    wnba_test12,
    data.frame(game_time = c(0, 40),
               home_margin = c(0, 3),
               home_prob = c(0.248, 1))
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
) %>%
  arrange(game_time) %>%
  mutate(home_prob = if_else((home_prob < 0.01 & game_time < 40), 0.01, home_prob),
         home_prob = if_else((home_prob > 0.99 & game_time < 40), 0.99, home_prob),
         proj_winner = if_else(home_prob >= 0.5, "Dallas", "Las Vegas"))







#add initial and terminal conditions
#adjust 0 or 1 probs
#add projected winner
#wnba_test13 <- wnba_test12 %>%
 # rbind(data.frame(game_time=c(0,40),
   #                home_margin=c(0,-14),
       #            home_prob=c(0.248,0))) %>%
#  arrange(game_time) %>%
 # mutate(home_prob=if_else((home_prob<0.01 & game_time<40),0.01,home_prob),
   #      home_prob=if_else((home_prob>0.99 & game_time<40),0.99,home_prob),
    #     proj_winner=if_else(home_prob>=0.5,"Dallas","Las Vegas"))

#create new rows between projection changes
wnba_test13b <- wnba_test13 %>%
  mutate(game_timeb=(game_time+lag(game_time,1))/2,
         home_marginb=0,
         home_probb=0.5,
         proj_winnerb=proj_winner,
         proj_shift=home_prob-0.5,
         proj_change=if_else(sign(proj_shift)!=
                               sign(lag(proj_shift,1)),1,0)) %>%
  filter(proj_change==1) %>%
  transmute(game_time=game_timeb,
            home_margin=home_marginb,
            home_prob=home_probb,
            proj_winner=proj_winnerb)

#add new rows to original data
#wnba_test14 <- wnba_test13 %>%
  #rbind(wnba_test13b) %>%
 # arrange(game_time)
wnba_test14 <- data.table::rbindlist(
  list(wnba_test13, wnba_test13b),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
) %>%
  arrange(game_time)








#create win probability line graph
ggplot(data=wnba_test14,
       mapping=aes(x=game_time,
                   y=home_prob,
                   color=proj_winner,
                   group=1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(10,20,30),
             linetype="dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.5) +
  labs(title="Las Vegas at Dallas 8/28/24",
       subtitle = "Logistic Regression Model, Accuracy: 77.68%",
       x="Game Time (minutes)",
       y="Home Win Probability",
       color="Projected\nWinner",
       caption="Produced by Luke O'Neill") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,40),breaks=seq(0,40,5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,1),breaks=seq(0,1,0.1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#39FF14","#C0C0C0")) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
library(gganimate)

           y = home_prob,

  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +

    subtitle = "Logistic Regression Model, Accuracy: 77.68%",
    x = "Game Time (minutes)",
    y = "Home Win Probability",
    color = "Projected\nWinner",
    caption = "Produced by Luke O'Neill"
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,40), breaks = seq(0,40,5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#39FF14","#C0C0C0")) +
  theme_bw() +

  transition_reveal(game_time)





animate(anim_plot,
        fps = 20,
        duration = 10,
        width = 900,
        height = 500,
        renderer = gifski_renderer())
```
